preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 50,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 500000 for N in [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not any(c.isdigit() for c in line.split()[0] if c.isdigit() and len(line.split()) > 1])]
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is between 2 and 500,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= x <= 100000 for x in A) and all(1 <= x <= 100000 for x in B) for A, B in [([int(x) for x in line.split()], [int(x) for x in next_line.split()]) for line, next_line in zip(stdin_text.splitlines()[1::3], stdin_text.splitlines()[2::3]) if line.strip() and next_line.strip()])
preconditions.description: All elements in arrays A and B are integers between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: sum(N for N in [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and len(line.split()) == 1]) <= 500000
preconditions.description: The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(sorted(A) == sorted(B) for A, B in [([int(x) for x in line.split()], [int(x) for x in next_line.split()]) for line, next_line in zip(stdin_text.splitlines()[1::3], stdin_text.splitlines()[2::3]) if line.strip() and next_line.strip()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, array B is a permutation of array A (guaranteed by problem statement).

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(int(line) == max_score(A, B) for line, (A, B) in zip(stdout_text.strip().splitlines(), zip([int(x) for x in line.split() for line in stdin_text.splitlines()[1::3] if line.strip()], [int(x) for x in line.split() for line in stdin_text.splitlines()[2::3] if line.strip()])))
postconditions.description: Each output line contains the maximum possible score achievable by converting array A to array B using the allowed swap operations.
